name: party-deposition
description: Builds element-driven deposition outlines and witness preparation plans for U.S. party depositions (plaintiff or defendant), covering admissions under FRE 801(d)(2), damages/causation modules, and FRCP 30 procedures. Use when drafting a party deposition outline, preparing a party witness, planning admissions strategy, or testing defenses. Trigger keywords: party deposition, plaintiff deposition, defendant deposition, deposition outline, witness prep, admissions, damages, causation, mitigation.
